results.text: Monitoring Serum Bisoprolol Concentrations in Patients With Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction: Results of a Pilot Study From Routine Health Care. Bisoprolol is a second-generation, highly selective beta-1 adrenergic receptor antagonist with various beneficial effects in patients with heart failure.
